posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
I've been suffering unexpected crashes for some time, probably due to my browser being more ancient and terrible than anything in that book of Nightmist's.  But today, I noticed this weird message at the top of the page after posting in the Cosmic Omnitron game thread:

"Oops, looks like this request tried to create an infinite loop. We do not allow such things here. We are a professional website!"

I know this is probably not enough information for a proper bug report, but it was all I could come up with offhand.
